expectations.text: Identifies that AnalyticsService imports the concrete AnalyticsRepository class instead of an interface
expectations.evidence: Violation 1: 'import { AnalyticsRepository } from './repository';   // imports the CONCRETE class' — 'The Application layer (service.ts) must depend on an interface (port) defined in the Domain layer, not on a concrete infrastructure class.'

expectations.text: Flags that AnalyticsService self-instantiates AnalyticsRepository via new (bypasses composition root / DI)
expectations.evidence: Violation 2: 'constructor() { this.repo = new AnalyticsRepository(); }' — 'The composition root (platform/container.ts) is the only place that should construct concrete implementations... When a service constructs its own collaborators, it bypasses the container entirely. This is the service locator anti-pattern.'

expectations.text: Identifies that routes.ts imports AnalyticsRepository directly (presentation → infrastructure violation)
expectations.evidence: Violation 3: 'import { AnalyticsRepository } from './repository';  // infrastructure import in presentation' — 'The Presentation layer (routes.ts) must depend on the Application layer only. It must not import from infrastructure (repository.ts, db/schema, drizzle-orm) or bypass the service layer.'

expectations.text: Flags the raw db query in routes.ts /analytics/live that bypasses the service layer
expectations.evidence: Violation 3: '/analytics/live bypasses ALL layers — raw SQL query in a route handler' with code showing 'const rows = await db.select().from(pageViews).orderBy(desc(pageViews.timestamp)).limit(10);' inside the route handler.

expectations.text: Recommends extracting an IAnalyticsRepository interface (port) in the domain layer
expectations.evidence: Violation 5 and Fix for Violation 1: 'Add domain/ports.ts as shown in Violation 1's fix. This is the prerequisite for every other fix.' — provides concrete interface: 'export interface AnalyticsPort { record(view: PageView): Promise<void>; getDashboardStats(fromDate: Date): Promise<DashboardStats>; getRecentViews(limit: number): Promise<PageView[]>; }'
